id: title:Gilbert09:keep the aggregate window within mux s standard retention

review.posthog_relevance: Reduces aggregate metrics lookback window to comply with Mux API retention limits, preventing API rejection for accounts lacking paid add-ons.
review.reason: The chunk explicitly changes the aggregate lookback setting from 395 days to 90 days and updates the corresponding test assertion. This is a substantive, bounded change to the configuration and its validation. The implementation of the change is not shown, but the configuration and test updates are sufficient to establish a tier 2 contribution.
review.uncertainty: The actual implementation of the 90-day lookback is not visible in this chunk; the tier relies on the configuration and test changes. The benefit is operational compliance rather than a demonstrated runtime improvement.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the new test, only the test definition and the assertion. The implementation of the aggregate lookback change is not shown, so the tier cannot be assigned.

observations.behavior: Removes the 395-day aggregate lookback and replaces it with a 90-day lookback, while retaining the 30-day video views lookback.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces the historical window for aggregate metrics requests to stay within Mux's standard 100-day retention, avoiding API rejection on accounts without the paid 13-month add-on.
